records: What did Yahweh tell Jonah to do?
Yahweh told Jonah to get up and go to Nineveh and speak out against it.
What did Jonah do after Yahweh told him to go to Nineveh?
Jonah got up to run away to Tarshish from before the face of Yahweh.
What did Yahweh do to the ship which Jonah had boarded?
Yahweh sent a great wind and a great storm on the sea so that the ship was near to being broken up.
To whom did the sailors cry out in the midst of the storm?
The sailors became very afraid and each cried out to his own god.
How did the sailors determine who was the cause of the evil?
The sailors cast lots to determine the cause of the evil and the lot indicated Jonah.
What was the result of casting lots?
The result was that the lot indicated that Jonah was the cause of the evil they were experiencing.
How did the sailors know that Jonah was running away from before the face of Yahweh?
The sailors knew that Jonah was running away from before the face of Yahweh because Jonah told them.
What did Jonah tell the men to do in order to stop the storm?
Jonah told the men to lift him up and throw him into the sea.
What two requests did the sailors make of Yahweh?
The sailors asked Yahweh to not let them perish on account of the life of Jonah and to not hold them guilty for Jonah’s death.
What happened when the sailors threw Jonah into the sea?
When the sailors threw Jonah into the sea, the sea stopped raging.
What happened to Jonah when the sailors threw him into the sea?
Yahweh appointed a great fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was in the abdomen of the fish three days and three nights.
What did Jonah do in the belly of the fish?
Jonah cried out to Yahweh in prayer because he was distressed.
What did Jonah hope he might be able to do again?
Jonah hoped that he might be able to look toward Yahweh’s holy temple again.
From where did Yahweh bring up Jonah’s life?
Yahweh brought Jonah’s life up from the pit.
What did Jonah say happens to those who give attention to empty vanities?
Jonah said those who give attention to empty vanities forsake their covenant faithfulness.
When Jonah prayed in the belly of the fish, what did he say that he would do?
Jonah said he would sacrifice to Yahweh with a voice of thanksgiving and fulfill what he had vowed.
To whom did Jonah say salvation belongs?
Jonah said that salvation belongs to Yahweh.
How did Yahweh respond to Jonah’s prayer?
Yahweh spoke to the fish and it vomited Jonah up onto the dry land.
What did Yahweh command Jonah to do for the second time?
Yahweh commanded Jonah to go to Nineveh and speak Yahweh’s message.
How did Jonah respond the second time Yahweh told him to go to Nineveh?
Jonah obeyed Yahweh and went to Nineveh.
What message did Jonah speak in Nineveh?
Jonah said that in 40 days Nineveh would be overthrown.
How did the Ninevites respond to Yahweh’s message that Jonah preached?

The Ninevites believed God, fasted, and put on sackcloth. The king of Nineveh made a decree which said that no person or animal should eat or drink water and that each person and animal must be covered with sackcloth and that each person should cry out to God and stop doing evil deeds including violent acts.
What hope did the king of Nineveh have for the people of Nineveh and the city?
The king of Nineveh hoped that God would turn back from his anger and have compassion on them so that the people of Nineveh would not perish.
How did God respond to the Ninevites’ repentance?
God saw their deeds, that they turned away from their evil ways. And God relented in regard to the evil that he had said he would do to them; and he did not do it.
Jonah was angry because it seemed like a great evil to Jonah that Yahweh had mercy on the Ninevites and did not punish them.
Why did Jonah say that he had tried to flee to Tarshish?
Jonah said that he had tried to flee to Tarshish because he knew that Yahweh was a gracious and compassionate God, slow to anger and abundant in covenant faithfulness, and one who relents from evil.
What did Jonah ask Yahweh to do to him?
Jonah asked Yahweh to take his life.
What question did Yahweh ask Jonah?
Yahweh asked Jonah if it was right for Jonah to be angry.
Why did Jonah go out of the city and sit down facing the city?
Jonah wanted to see what would happen to the city of Nineveh.
What did Yahweh do for Jonah while he sat outside the city?
Yahweh caused a plant to grow up over Jonah to be a shade for his head.
What did Yahweh do to the plant that had provided shade for Jonah?
God appointed a worm at the rising of the dawn of the next day; and it attacked the plant, and it withered.
What question did Yahweh ask Jonah after Yahweh caused the plant to wither and a hot east wind to blow on Jonah?
Yahweh asked Jonah if it was right for him to be angry about the plant.
How did Jonah feel when the plant that had given him shade withered and died?
Jonah felt compassion for the plant that had withered and died.
For whom did Yahweh feel compassion?
Yahweh felt compassion for the people and animals in Nineveh.
Who were the kings of Judah when the word of Yahweh came to Micah?
Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were kings of Judah when the word of Yahweh came to Micah.
From where will the Lord Yahweh testify against the peoples?
The Lord Yahweh will testify against the peoples from the holy place where he rules in heaven.
On what will Yahweh come down and tread?
Yahweh will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
What will happen to the mountains and valleys when Yahweh comes down?
The mountains will melt under him, and the valleys will split open.
Why will Yahweh bring this judgment?
Yahweh will bring this judgment because the people of Israel, the descendants of Jacob, have sinned against him.
What will Yahweh do to Samaria?
Yahweh will make Samaria a heap of rubble with no stones or foundations left standing, only empty fields.
How did Samaria get her carved images and idols?
Samaria got her carved images and idols using money paid at the idol temples to prostitutes who served there.
How did Micah express his mourning over the sin and coming judgement of Israel and Jacob?
Micah wept and wailed, and went barefoot and naked to show his deep mourning.
It has reached the city of Jerusalem, the city of Yahweh’s people.
What should the people do in Beth Leaphrah?
They should roll themselves in the dust to show mourning.
What will the mourning of Beth Ezel show?
Beth Ezel will no longer be able to help them stand against their enemies.
What has Yahweh allowed to happen instead of the good things that the people of Maroth were waiting for?
Yahweh allowed terrible things to happen all the way to Jerusalem.
What city led the people of Zion to sin?
The city of Lachish led Zion into sin because they caused them to rebel against Yahweh.
What will the town of Achzib become to the kings of Israel?
Achzib will become a deception to the kings of Israel.
Who will Yahweh bring to the people of Mareshah?
Yahweh will bring a conqueror to take over the town of Mareshah.
Why should the Israelites shave their heads?
They should shave their heads to show that they are mourning for their children who will go into exile.
Who is this warning being given to?
The warning is being given to those who are lying awake in their beds planning to do evil.
What do these wicked people do to fields and houses that belong to other people?
They forcefully take fields, steal houses that belong to other people, and cheat people of their inheritance.
What does Yahweh say his judgment will be?
Yahweh says he is planning disaster against them, and they will not be able to escape it.
Why will the people say that Yahweh has taken their portion from them?
They people will say Yahweh has given the land they inherited to their enemies.
What will happen in the future when the people of Yahweh assemble to divide up the land by lots?
Those receiving this judgment will not receive any part of it.
What do the false prophets tell the true prophet not to do?
They tell him not to prophesy about these things.
Who do the words of Yahweh spoken through Micah help?
His words help those who walk uprightly and do what is right.
From whom do Yahweh’s people strip the robe?
They strip the robes from those who feel safe because they are among their own people.
What do the wicked leaders do to the women of Yahweh’s people?
They force the women out of the homes that they love.
Why should Yahweh’s people get up and leave?
They should get up and leave for this was not a place where they could safely live since Yahweh will destroy it because of their sins.
What kind of prophet would the people accept?
They would accept a lying prophet who promises them wine and beer.
Who will gather the remnant of Israel?
Yahweh will gather the remnant of Israel.
Who will lead the people out through the gate?
Their king will go in front of them, and Yahweh will be leading them.
What does Micah say the leaders of Israel should know?
Micah says they should know how to treat people fairly.
What do the leaders love, and what do they hate?
The leaders love what is evil and hate what is good.
Who does Micah accuse of acting like butchers?
He accuses the leaders of oppressing the people as if they butchered and ate them.
Why will Yahweh refuse to help the leaders when they cry out to him?
Yahweh will not help the leaders because they have done evil deeds.
What do the prophets promise to people who feed them?
The prophets promise peace to people who feed them.
Why will the prophets no longer be able to see visions?
Yahweh will no longer show them anything.
What will the seers and diviners do because God does not answer them?
They will be in mourning and be ashamed and disgraced.
What does Micah do because Yahweh’s Spirit empowers him?
Micah declares to the people of Israel how they have rebelled and sinned against God.
The leaders hate it when people do what is right.
How do the leaders build up Jerusalem?
The leaders build up Jerusalem through bloodshed and injustice.
What do the leaders expect before giving a favorable judgment?
The leaders will only judge favorably for those who give them bribes.
What will happen to Jerusalem and the temple hill?
Jerusalem will be leveled and become a pile of rubble, and the temple hill will become an overgrown forest.
What will happen in the last days?
In the last days, the mountain where Yahweh’s temple stands will become more important than all the other mountains.
Why will many nations want to go to the mountain of Yahweh?
Many nations will want to go to the mountain of Yahweh to learn about how he wants them to live.
What will the nations make from their swords and spears?
The nations will make farming tools from their weapons of war.
Where will each person sit after Yahweh brings peace?
Each person will sit under his own vine and under his own fig tree, and no one will make them afraid.
Who the other people groups obey?
The other people groups obey their own false gods.
Yahweh will gather all those whom he had caused to suffer.
Where will Yahweh reign over his people forever?
Yahweh will reign over them forever on Mount Zion.
What will come back to Jerusalem?
The former authority will come back and the kingdom will once again be centered in Jerusalem.
To what does the prophet compare the pain Jerusalem is experiencing?
They are experiencing pain like a woman giving birth.
Where will the people of Jerusalem be rescued?
The people of Jerusalem will be rescued in Babylon.
What do the nations gathered against Zion say they want to do?
They say they want to destroy the city and see the ruins of Zion.
Who does not know Yahweh’s thoughts?
The nations do not know Yahweh’s thoughts.
To whom will the people of Jerusalem devote the wealth of many peoples?
They will devote the wealth of many peoples to Yahweh.
With has the enemy done to Jerusalem?
The enemy has surrounded the city and laid siege to it.
From where will one come to be a ruler in Israel?
One who will be a ruler in Israel will come from Bethlehem Ephrathah.
For how long will God allow the people of Israel to be conquered by their enemies?
God will allow their enemies to conquer them until the time when the woman gives birth to her child.
Who will shepherd his flock in the strength of Yahweh?
The ruler will shepherd his flock in the strength of Yahweh.
What will Assyria do when they come into the land?
Assyria will attack and break through their fortresses.
Who will rescue the people from Assyria?
The promised ruler will rescue them from Assyria when they invade the land.
How is the remnant of Israel like the dew on the grass?
Just like Yahweh sends the dew and the rain to make things grow, so the remnant is completely dependent on Yahweh to make them a blessing to other peoples.
What is the remnant of Jacob compared to among the nations?
The remnant of Jacob is compared to a lion attacking a flock of sheep.
What will happen when the hand of Yahweh rises against his enemies?
Yahweh will destroy all of his enemies by the power of his hand.
What did Yahweh say he would do to the horses and chariots?
Yahweh said he would destroy the horses and the chariots.
What did Yahweh say he would do to the cities and fortifications?
Yahweh said he would destroy the cities and tear down all the fortifications.
What did Yahweh say he would do about sorceries and soothsayers?
Yahweh said he would stop their witchcraft and fortune telling.
What did Yahweh say he would do to the idols and stone pillars?
Yahweh said he would take away the idols and stone pillars, and the people would no longer worship what they made with their own hands.
What did Yahweh say he would do to the Asherah poles and the cities?
Yahweh said he would remove the Asherah poles and destroy the cities.
Yahweh will punish the people of the nations that have not listened and obeyed him.
What does Yahweh say to do before the mountains and hills?
Yahweh says to stand up and present his case, with the mountains and hills as witnesses.
What will Yahweh do against Israel?
Yahweh will bring charges against Israel.
What did Yahweh invite his people to do if they have anything against him?
He tells them that if they have any cause to complain, they can testify against him.
Who did Yahweh send to lead his people out of Egypt?
Yahweh sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to lead his people.
What does Yahweh want his people to remember?
Yahweh wants his people to remember how God miraculously helped them in the past.
What does the speaker ask about coming before Yahweh?
He asks whether he should come before Yahweh with burnt offerings or sacrifice year-old calves.
What does the speaker ask if he should give for his sin?
He asks whether he should sacrifice his firstborn child for his sin.
What did Yahweh require from his people?
Yahweh required his people to act justly, love being faithful to others, and walk humbly with their God.
Who is Yahweh calling out his message to?
Yahweh is calling out his message to the people of the city of Jerusalem, the whole tribe of Israel, and the leaders he has appointed.
Yahweh has cursed the dishonest measures that wicked people use to cheat others.
Who is not innocent, according to Yahweh?
No one who uses dishonest scales or a bag of deceptive weights is innocent.
Who are those who are speaking lies?
The people who live in Jerusalem tell lies.
Why will Yahweh ruin the city?
Yahweh will ruin the city because of the sins of the people.
What will happen when the people eat, according to Yahweh?
They will eat but not be satisfied, because it will not stay inside them.
What will the people plant and press but not enjoy?
They will plant crops but not harvest them, press olives but not use the oil, and crush grapes but not drink the wine.
Whose laws did the people of city follow?
They followed the wicked laws and practices that their previous evil kings, Omri and Ahab, had established.
What does Micah say he is like?
Micah says he is as frustrated as someone who looks for fruit after the harvest but cannot find any cluster of grapes or an early fig to eat.
Who has perished from the land?
All the faithful people have disappeared from the land.
What do government officials and judges demand?
Government officials and judges demand bribes.
Who foretold the time when God would punish those who do evil?
The prophets foretold the time when God would punish those who do evil.
Whom does Micah say not to trust?
Micah says not to trust a neighbor or a friend.
A man’s enemies are the people of his own household.
Who does Micah say will hear him?
Micah says Yahweh, the God of his salvation, will hear him.
What would happen after the nation is defeated?
Even though their enemies will defeat them, they will recover.
For how long will the people bear Yahweh’s rage?
They will bear Yahweh’s rage until Yahweh defends them and makes things right.
Micah will watch as his enemy’s homes are destroyed.
What will happen when the time comes to build the walls?
When the time comes to build the walls, the boundaries will be extended very far.
What will happen to the land because of the deeds of its people?
The land will become an empty wasteland because of the evil deeds of its people.
How does Micah ask Yahweh to shepherd his people?
Micah asks Yahweh to shepherd his people with his rod.
What will Yahweh do for his people?
Yahweh will do amazing things for them.
What will the nations see and be ashamed of?
They will see what Yahweh has done and be ashamed of how powerful they thought they were.
Who will the nations approach and be afraid of?
The nations will approach Yahweh and they will be afraid because of him.
Why will Yahweh not keep his anger forever?
Yahweh will not keep his anger forever, because he loves to faithfully love us.
What will Yahweh do with all the sins of the people of Israel?
Yahweh will forgive all their sins as if he is throwing all their sins into the depths of the sea.
What will Yahweh show to Jacob and Abraham?
Yahweh will show trustworthiness to Jacob and covenant faithfulness to Abraham, as he promised their ancestors long ago.
On whom does Yahweh take vengeance?
Yahweh takes vengeance on his adversaries.
Where does Yahweh make his way?
Yahweh makes his way in the whirlwind and the storm.
What is happening to the flowers of Lebanon?
What happens to the earth in Yahweh’s presence?
The earth heaves in Yahweh’s presence.
To what can we compare Yahweh in the day of trouble?
Yahweh is a stronghold in the day of trouble.
Into what will Yahweh pursue his enemies?
Yahweh will pursue his enemies with darkness, meaning “terrible things.”
What will Yahweh do to the people’s yoke?
He will break the people’s yoke from upon them.
Why will Yahweh dig graves for the people of Nineveh?
He will dig their graves because they are worthless.
Where are the feet of him who brings good news?
On the mountains are the feet of the herald who brings good news.
Why should Judah celebrate the festivals and keep vows?
Judah should celebrate its festivals and keep vows because the wicked one will invade them no more.
Yahweh has restored the majesty of Jacob.
What color are the shields of his mighty men?
The shields of his mighty men are red.
The chariots speed through the streets.
It has been decreed: the queen is taken away into exile; her female servants moan like doves, beating their breasts.
What will the people of Nineveh do?
They will flee away without turning back.
Of what were the lions afraid?
With what did the lion fill his cave and his dens?
The lion filled his cave with victims and his dens with carcasses.
What will Yahweh do to Nineveh?
Yahweh will burn their chariots in the smoke, devour their young lions, and cut off their prey from the land.
Of what is the city full?
The city is full of blood, lies and stolen property.
How many people will be killed by the attacking horsemen?
There will be heaps of corpses, a great pile of bodies, and no end of the bodies.
This is happening because of the harlotries of the beautiful prostitute.
What will Yahweh of hosts do against the prostitute because he is against her?

Yahweh will raise up her skirt over her face and show her private parts to the nations and her shame to the kingdoms. He will throw disgusting filth on her and make her vile. He will make her someone that everyone will look at.
Who threw lots for Thebes’ honorable men?
Thebes’ enemies threw lots for her honorable men.
If Nineveh’s fortresses are shaken, what happens?
If Nineveh’s fortresses are shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater.
How many guards and generals are there?
The guards and generals are as many as a swarm of locusts.
What will everyone who hears the news about you do?
Everyone who hears the news about you will clap their hands in joy over you.
What does Habakkuk ask Yahweh at the beginning of his complaint?
Habakkuk asks Yahweh how long he must cry for help without being heard or saved.
What is Habakkuk being made to see?
Habakkuk is being made to see iniquity and trouble, and destruction and violence are before him, along with strife and contention.
What kind of justice is going forth?
What does Yahweh say he is doing among the nations?
Yahweh says he is raising up the Chaldeans, a bitter and swift nation, to march through the earth and seize territory that is not theirs.
What kind of people are the Chaldeans?
The Chaldeans are dreadful and terrifying people.
What do the Chaldeans gather as they come with violence?
The Chaldeans gather captives like the sand.
What is the Chaldeans’ attitude toward other kings and rulers?
The Chaldeans mock at other kings and rulers.
What has Yahweh appointed the Chaldeans to do?
Yahweh has appointed the Chaldeans for judgment and established them for correcting his people.
What titles does Habakkuk use for Yahweh?
Habakkuk uses the titles “my God,” “Holy One,” and “Rock” for Yahweh.
What does Habakkuk ask Yahweh about the wicked?
Habakkuk asks Yahweh why he looks at treacherous people and remains silent when the wicked devour those more righteous than themselves.
Why do the Chaldeans rejoice and exult?
They rejoice because they gather up people like fish, pulling them in with nets and dragnets.
What does Habakkuk compare to the Chaldeans’ gathering of people?
Habakkuk compares the gathering of people to a fisherman catching fish with a hook, a net, and a dragnet.
What does Habakkuk ask about whether the Chaldeans will show to the nations?
Habakkuk asks whether the Chaldeans will spare the nations or keep destroying them without mercy.
For what was Habakkuk watching carefully?
Habakkuk was watching carefully to see what Yahweh would say to him and what he would respond concerning his complaint.
What did Yahweh tell Habakkuk to do with the vision?
Yahweh told Habakkuk to write the vision and make it plain on the tablets.
What assurance did Yahweh give Habakkuk about the vision?
Yahweh assured Habakkuk that the vision was for the appointed time, that it would not lie, and that even if it seemed to delay, it would certainly come and would not be late.
How did Yahweh say the righteous will live?
Yahweh said the righteous will live by his faithfulness.
According to this taunt, what two things are never satisfied?
The taunt says that Sheol and death are never satisfied, just as the arrogant conqueror is never satisfied and keeps gathering more nations and peoples to himself.
According to the taunt, what will happen to the one who plundered many nations?
The taunt says that the remainder of the peoples will plunder him in return, because of the bloodshed and violence he brought upon lands, cities, and their people.
What does the woe in verse 9 say about the one who gains evil gain for his house?
The woe says that he sets his nest on high thinking he will be delivered from evil, but he has only counseled shame for his house.
According to the taunt, what will cry out and answer because of the wrongdoing?
The taunt says that a stone will cry out from the wall, and a beam from the wood will answer it.
What does the woe in verse 12 say about the one who builds a city with bloodshed?
The woe says that the one who builds a city with bloodshed and establishes a town with injustice will see the peoples’ labor go up in fire and the nations weary themselves for nothing.
What does Yahweh promise will happen in the future?
Yahweh promises that the earth will be filled with knowing the glory of Yahweh, just as waters cover the sea.
What does the woe in verse 15 say about the one who causes his neighbor to drink?
The woe says that he pours out his wineskin and makes his neighbor drunk in order to look upon their nakedness.
What will come to the one who caused his neighbor to drink and exposed their nakedness?
The cup of the right hand of Yahweh will come around to him, and he will receive disgrace instead of glory.
In what is the maker of a carved image placing his trust?
He is placing his trust in his own handiwork, making mute idols that cannot speak.
What must all the earth do because Yahweh is in his holy temple?
All the earth must be silent before Yahweh.
Having heard Yahweh’s report, what is Habakkuk’s emotional response?
Having heard Yahweh’s report, Habakkuk is afraid.
What does Habakkuk ask Yahweh to remember?
Habakkuk asks Yahweh to remember compassion in his wrath.
When God came, what went before and after him?
When God came, plague went before him and fiery bolts went out at his feet.
What did Yahweh do to the nations when he looked at them?
Yahweh made the nations spring apart when he looked at them.
Yahweh went out for the salvation of his people and his anointed one.
What does Yahweh do to the head of the house of the wicked?
Yahweh strikes the head from the house of the wicked.
What did the wicked warriors do as they came to scatter Yahweh’s people?
As they came to scatter Yahweh’s people, the wicked warriors exulted as if to devour the afflicted in secret.
For what is Habakkuk waiting quietly?
Habakkuk is waiting quietly for the day of distress to come upon the people who attack them.
Habakkuk describes fig trees not blossoming, no produce on the vines, the olive failing, fields producing no food, the flock cut off, and no cattle in the stalls.
Despite the hardships, what will Habakkuk do?
Despite the hardships, Habakkuk will exult in Yahweh and rejoice in the God of his salvation.
What does Yahweh the Lord do for Habakkuk?
Yahweh the Lord is Habakkuk’s strength, makes his feet like a deer’s, and makes him tread on his high places.
What did Yahweh say he would do to man, beast, the birds of the skies, and the fish of the sea?
God said He would destroy them and cut them off.
Yahweh said he would cut off every remnant of a certain false god. What false god did he name?
He would cut off every remnant of Baal.
People were going up onto their housetops and bowing down to something. What was it?
The ones on the housetops worship the heavenly bodies.
What did Zephaniah tell the people to do in the presence (face) of Yahweh?
They were to be silent in the presence of Yahweh.
What were the people doing whom Yahweh said he would “visit” (punish)?
Yahweh will punish the princes and the king’s sons, everyone dressed in foreign clothes, those who leap over the door sill, and those who fill their master’s house with violence and deceit.
What sounds did Yahweh say would come up from the Fish Gate and the Second Quarter?
A cry of distress, and wailing will come in that day.
What did Yahweh say would happen to the “people of Canaan” (merchants)?
They will be ruined, and all those who are weighed down with silver will be cut off.
What were some of the people saying about Yahweh?
They said, “Yahweh will not do anything, either good or evil!”
Who will cry out on the great day of Yahweh?
The great day of Yahweh will be a day of fury, anguish, and darkness.
What will happen to the blood and innards of people who have sinned against Yahweh?
Those who have sinned against God.
What will not be able to deliver people from the wrath of Yahweh?
Their silver and their gold will not be able to save them.
Zephaniah says that people may be spared (hidden from) Yahweh’s anger if they do something. What should they do?
The people must seek righteousness and humility to avoid Yahweh’s wrath.
What will happen to the cities of Gaza, Ashkelon, Ashdod, and Ekron?
All peoples who will not heed the warning of Yahweh will be uprooted and destroyed.
What two cities will Moab and the sons of Ammon become like?
Moab will become like Sodom, and the people of Ammon like Gomorrah.
What kind of birds will nest in the top of Assyria’s columns?
Owls will nest in the tops of Assyria’s pillars.
What will people do who pass by “the exultant city” (Nineveh)?
The exultant city will become a horror, a place for beasts to lie down in.
To what animals does Zephaniah compare these princes and judges?
The princes of the violent city are like roaring lions.
When does Yahweh give his justice?
Yahweh will dispense justice from morning to morning.
What did Yahweh want the people to do?
Yahweh hoped the people would fear him and accept correction.
What did Yahweh say his judgment (decision) was?
Yahweh has decided to assemble the nations and pour out his anger and wrath on them.
What will the peoples do once Yahweh has given them a “pure lip”?
Yahweh will call the people to serve him standing shoulder to shoulder.
What things will the remnant of Israel no longer do?
The remnant of Israel will no longer commit injustice and speak lies.
Why should the “daughter of Jerusalem” (the people who live in Jerusalem) rejoice and exult?
Israel should sing and cheer because Yahweh has taken away their punishment.
Yahweh says that he will turn the shame of the Israelites into something else. Into what?
Yahweh will rescue the lame and gather together the outcast.
What will Yahweh restore to the Israelites?
All the nations will respect and praise Israel when they see that Yahweh has restored them.
When was the word of Yahweh by the hand of Haggai the prophet?
The word was in the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, on the first day of the month.
To whom was the word of Yahweh?
The word was to Zerubbabel the governor and Joshua the high priest.
What did Yahweh claim that the people said?
He claimed that they said the time had not come to rebuild Yahweh’s house.
What was the condition of Yahweh’s house while the people lived in their finished houses?
What did Yahweh command the people to do?
Yahweh commanded the people to go up to the mountain and bring timber and build his house.
Why did Yahweh blow away the little food that the people were able to bring home?
Yahweh blew it away because his house was desolate but each person was running to his own house.
How did Zerubbabel the governor, Joshua the priest, and all the remnant of the people respond to Yahweh’s voice and the words of Haggai the prophet?
They all listened to Yahweh’s voice and Haggai’s words because Yahweh had sent him and they feared the face of Yahweh.
How did Yahweh respond to the people’s obedience?
Yahweh sent a message to them through Haggai to tell them, “I am with you!”
When did Yahweh awaken the spirits of Zerubbabel the governor, Joshua the priest, and all the remnant of the people so that they came and worked on the house of Yahweh?
Yahweh awakened their spirits on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month in the second year of Darius the king.
When was the word of Yahweh again by the hand of Haggai the prophet?
The word was in the seventh month, on the twenty-first day of the month.

Although the house of Yahweh was like nothing in the eyes of those who saw it in its former glory, why did Yahweh declare that Zerubbabel the governor, Joshua the high priest, and all the people should be strong and work?
Yahweh declared that they should be strong and work because he was with them.
What did Yahweh tell Zerubbabel, Joshua, and all the people not to do?
Yahweh told them not to fear.
What would happen when Yahweh shook the heavens, earth, and every nation?
People would come with the treasure of all the nations and Yahweh would fill his house with glory.
According to the priests, if a man carries holy flesh (sacrificed meat) in his garment and his garment touches other food, does that other food become holy?
According to the priests, that other food does not become holy.
According to the priests, if someone who is unclean by a person (that is, through contact with a dead body) touches any food, does that food become unclean?
According to the priests, that food becomes unclean.
The people were offering sacrifices on an altar at the temple. What did Yahweh consider those sacrifices to be like?
Yahweh considered those sacrifices to be as unclean as food that was touched by someone who was unclean through contact with a dead body.
Before the people began to rebuild the temple of Yahweh, how many measures of grain would they find in a heap where they thought there would be twenty measures?
The people would find only ten measures of grain in a heap where they thought there would be twenty measures.
When Yahweh struck the people with blight and mildew and hail, did the people obey him?
No, the people did not obey Yahweh.
How long were the people supposed to think back about what had been happening to them?
They were to think back to the time when the temple of Yahweh was founded.
What did Yahweh promise he would do starting on the day Haggai was speaking?
Yahweh promised that from that day forward he would bless the people.
What did Yahweh say he would do when he shook the heavens and the earth?
Yahweh said that he would overthrow the throne of kingdoms and destroy their strength. The armies of the nations would destroy one another’s chariots and horses and their riders.
Yahweh told Zerubbabel that he would make him like a signet ring for a particular reason. What was that reason?
Yahweh told Zerubbabel that he would make him like a signet ring because Yahweh had chosen him.
During whose reign did Zechariah prophesy?
Zechariah prophesied during the reign of Darius.
Zechariah was the son of Berechiah and the grandson of Iddo, and he was a prophet.
How did Yahweh feel about the people’s fathers?
Yahweh was very angry with their fathers.
What did Yahweh of Armies say he would do if the people would return to him?
Yahweh of Armies said that if the people would return to him, he would return to them.
What did their fathers do when Yahweh told them to turn from their evil ways and evil deeds?
Their fathers would not hear and did not pay attention to Yahweh.
What did Yahweh ask about the fathers and the prophets?
To make his point, Yahweh asked where the fathers were and whether the prophets live forever.
What did the people say when they repented?
The people said that Yahweh of Armies had punished them for their behavior, just as he had planned and said he would do.
When did the word of Yahweh come to Zechariah a second time?
The word of Yahweh came to Zechariah on the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, the month of Shebat, in the second year of Darius.
What did Zechariah see when the word of Yahweh came to him in the night?
Zechariah saw a man riding on a red horse, standing among the myrtle trees in the deep valley. Behind him were red, reddish-brown, and white horses.
What did the angel say he would do for Zechariah?
The angel said he would show Zechariah what the horses were.
What were the horses that Zechariah saw?
The horses were those Yahweh had sent out to roam throughout the earth.
What did the horses who roamed throughout the earth find?
The horses found all the earth sitting and at rest.
What question did the angel of Yahweh have for Yahweh concerning Jerusalem and the cities of Judah?
The angel of Yahweh asked Yahweh how long he would show no compassion to Jerusalem and the cities of Judah.
How did Yahweh answer the angel?
Yahweh answered with good words, words of comfort.
What did the angel tell Zechariah to proclaim about Jerusalem and Zion?
The angel told Zechariah to proclaim that Yahweh, the commander of the heavenly armies, cares very deeply about Jerusalem and Zion.
What does Yahweh say about the nations that are at ease?
Yahweh says he is very angry with the nations that feel secure, because they made the harm to his people worse.
What did Yahweh of Armies say concerning Jerusalem and the cities of Judah?

Yahweh said he had returned to Jerusalem with mercies, that his house would be built within her, and the measuring line would be stretched out over Jerusalem. Yahweh also said his cities would once again overflow with goodness and Yahweh would again comfort Zion and once again choose Jerusalem.
What did Zechariah see when he lifted up his eyes?
What were the four horns that Zechariah saw?
The four horns were those who had scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.
Who were the four craftsmen that Zechariah saw and what were they going to do?
The craftsmen were coming to terrify the nations that had scattered Judah and to cast down the horns of the nations that had lifted up a horn against the land of Judah to scatter it.
What did the prophet see when he lifted up his eyes?
He saw a man with a measuring line in his hand.
What was the young man going to do with the measuring line in his hand?
He was going to measure Jerusalem, to determine its width and its length.
Who came out to meet the angel who was speaking with the prophet?
Another angel came out to meet him.
Why did the second angel say that Jerusalem would sit in the open country?
The second angel said this because of the multitudes of men and beasts that would be within her.
What did Yahweh say he would become for Jerusalem?
Yahweh said he would become a wall of fire around her and he would be the glory in her midst.
From where did Yahweh tell the people to flee?
Yahweh told them to flee from Babylon, because he had scattered them everywhere.
What did Yahweh tell the people living in Babylon to do?
Yahweh told them to escape from Babylon.
According to Yahweh, what happens to anyone who harms his people?
Anyone who harms them harms what is most precious to Yahweh.
How were they supposed to know that Yahweh of Armies had sent the second angel?
They would know that Yahweh of Armies had sent him when he waved his hand over the nations that had plundered Judah and Israel, and those nations would become plunder for their own slaves.
What did Yahweh tell the people of Zion to do?
Yahweh told them to sing and rejoice, because he was coming to live among them.
What will happen when Yahweh comes to live among his people?
Many nations will join themselves to Yahweh, and they will become his people.
What will Yahweh do with Judah?
Yahweh will claim Judah as his own special people in his holy land, and he will again choose Jerusalem.
Why is all flesh told to be silent before Yahweh?
All flesh is told to be silent before Yahweh because Yahweh has been roused from out of the heavens.
Who was standing near Joshua the high priest?
Joshua was standing before the angel of Yahweh, and the adversary was standing at his right hand.
What was the adversary doing at Joshua’s right hand?
The adversary was standing there to accuse Joshua.
What did Yahweh say to the adversary?
Yahweh rebuked the adversary and said that Yahweh had chosen Jerusalem. He also compared Joshua to a firebrand rescued from the fire.
What was Joshua wearing as he stood before the angel?
Joshua was dressed in filthy garments.
The angel commanded the filthy garments to be removed from Joshua and for him to be clothed with fine clothing. A clean turban and clean garments were put on him.
What did the angel say he had done for Joshua?
The angel said he had caused Joshua’s iniquity to pass away from him.
What did Yahweh promise Joshua if he would walk in Yahweh’s ways and keep his charge?
Yahweh promised that Joshua would judge Yahweh’s house and keep Yahweh’s courts. Yahweh also promised to give Joshua access among those who stand before him.
What was the servant called that Yahweh was going to bring?
That servant was called the Branch.
What does Yahweh say he will do with the iniquity of that land?
Yahweh says he will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.
According to Yahweh, when will each man call his neighbor to come under his vine and his fig tree?
Yahweh says this will happen in that day.
What did the angel do to Zechariah?
The angel who had been talking with him came back and woke him up.
What did Zechariah see when he was roused?
Zechariah saw a gold lampstand with a bowl on top, with seven lamps and two olive trees by the bowl.
Did Zechariah understand what the things in the vision meant?
No, Zechariah told the angel who was talking with him that he did not understand the meaning of those things in the vision.
What was the word of Yahweh to Zerubbabel about how things were going to get done?
The word of Yahweh to Zerubbabel was, “Not by might and not by power, but by my Spirit.”
What will be shouted when Zerubbabel brings out the top stone?
They will shout, “How beautiful! May God bless it!”
How will the people know that Yahweh sent Zechariah to them?
The people will know when they see that the hands of Zerubbabel, which founded this house, complete it.
What will the people see in the hand of Zerubbabel?
The people will see the plumb line in Zerubbabel’s hand.
What do the seven lamps mean?
The seven lamps are the eyes of Yahweh that roam over the whole earth.
What did Zechariah ask about the two olive trees beside the lampstand?
Zechariah asked what the two olive trees on the right and left of the lampstand meant.
He asked what were the two olive trees on either side of the lampstand.
What did Zechariah ask a second time?
He asked what the two olive branches beside the two gold pipes that pour out olive oil meant.
Zechariah asked about the two branches of the olives beside the pipes that pour out the oil.
Did Zechariah know what the two olive branches meant?
No, Zechariah told the angel that he did not know what they meant.
Did Zechariah know what the branches were?
What are the two olive branches?
The two olive branches are the two people whom God has anointed to serve the Lord who rules over the whole earth.
How big was the scroll that Zechariah saw?
The scroll was twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide.
What did the angel say the flying scroll was?
The angel said the flying scroll was the curse that goes out over the face of the whole earth.
The scroll was a curse to every thief and to everyone who swears falsely.
What did Yahweh say the curse would do to the house of the thief and the one who swears falsely by his name?
The curse will come to their houses and remain there and consume the timber and stones of their houses.
What did the angel tell Zechariah to do?
He told Zechariah to look up and see what is coming out.
What did the angel say the ephah that was going out was?
The angel said the ephah was their eye in all of the earth.
Where was the one woman sitting?
She was sitting inside the basket.
What did the angel say the woman in the ephah was?
The angel said the woman in the ephah was the wickedness.
What did the two women with wings like stork wings do with the ephah?
The two women lifted up the ephah between the earth and between the heavens.
What did Zechariah ask the angel?
He asked where they were taking the ephah.
Where were the women taking the ephah and for what purpose?
The women were taking the ephah to the land of Shinar to build a house for it, and when the house was ready, the ephah would be set there on its base.
What did Zechariah see coming out from between two bronze mountains?
Zechariah saw four chariots coming out from between two bronze mountains.
What color were the horses of each chariot?
The first chariot had red horses, the second had black horses, the third had white horses, and the fourth had spotted gray horses.
What did Zechariah ask the angel?
He asked the angel about the horses and chariots he saw.
What did the angel say the chariots were?
The angel said the chariots were the four winds of heaven.
Where had these four chariots been?
These four chariots had been standing before the Lord of all the earth.
Where were the three chariots with the black, the white and the spotted gray horses going?
The chariot with the black horses went out to the north country. The chariot with white horses went out to the west country. The chariot with the spotted gray horses went out to the south country.
What was the chariot with the black horses that went out to the north country going to accomplish?
That chariot with the black horses was going to appease the angel’s spirit concerning the north country.
What was Zechariah supposed to do with the offering he collected from Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah?

Zechariah was told to take the offering into the house of Josiah, son of Zephaniah. Zechariah was to take the silver and gold, make crowns and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest.
What did Yahweh of Armies say Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest, would see?
Yahweh said Joshua would see Branch build the temple of Yahweh, raise up its splendor, and then sit and rule on his throne.
Why were crowns to be placed in the temple of Yahweh?
Crowns were to be placed in the temple of Yahweh to as memorials to Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Hen the son of Zephaniah.
What must the people do for these prophetic events to come true?
Yahweh said these events would happen “if you truly listen to the voice of Yahweh your God!”
Why did the people of Bethel send Sharezer, Regem- Melech, and their men?
The people of Bethel sent them to beg for Yahweh’s favor.
What did Sharezer, Melech, and their men ask the priest and the prophets?
They asked, “Should I mourn in the fifth month by means of a fast, as I have done these many years?”
What two questions did Yahweh ask the people of the land and the priests through Zechariah concerning fasting, eating and drinking?

The first question Yahweh asked was, “When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month for these seventy years, were you truly fasting for me?” The second question was, “And when you ate and drank, did you not eat and drink for yourselves?”
Briefly, what was the last question Yahweh asked the priests and people of the land?
In brief, Yahweh asked if these were not the same words Yahweh told the people while they still inhabited Jerusalem, the surrounding cities, the Negev, and the western foothills.
Through Zechariah, what did Yahweh tell the people to do?
Yahweh said to judge with true justice, covenant faithfulness, and mercy. He said not to oppress the widow, the orphan, the foreigner or the poor person and not to do evil to one another.
What was the response of the people to Yahweh’s instructions?
The people refused to pay attention to Yahweh’s words.
How did the people keep from hearing the law and words of Yahweh?
They made their heart as a rock and would not listen.
What did Yahweh say he would do when those who formerly refused to listen to Yahweh called out to him?
Yahweh said he would not listen to them and, furthermore, he would scatter those people with a whirlwind to all the nations they had not seen.
How does Yahweh express his passion for Zion?
Yahweh expresses his passion for Zion with great zeal and great anger.
What will Jerusalem and the mountain of Yahweh be called when Yahweh returns to live in the midst of Jerusalem?
Jerusalem will be called “the city of faithfulness,” and the mountain of Yahweh will be called “the mountain of holiness.”
Who will again be found in the open areas of Jerusalem?
Old men and old women will sit in the open areas, and boys and girls will fill the open areas, playing there.
How will these events seem to the remnant of the people who survive, compared to how they seem to Yahweh?
These events will seem wonderful to the remnant of the people, but they will not seem wonderful to Yahweh.
Where is Yahweh going to rescue his people from?
Yahweh is going to rescue his people from the land of the sunrise and from the land of the setting sun.
What will Yahweh do for the people he brings back to Jerusalem?
Yahweh will be their God and they will be his people; he will be faithful to them and treat them fairly.
Why did Yahweh want the people to strengthen their hands?
Yahweh wanted the people to strengthen their hands so the temple could be rebuilt.
What happened before those days when the foundation of Yahweh’s house was laid?

Before that time, no one earned wages for their work, and no one could hire animals for work; no one was safe going about their daily activities because of enemies, and Yahweh caused everyone to fight against one another.
How did Yahweh say it would be during Zechariah’s time?

Yahweh said it would not be as in the former days. He said the seed of peace would be sown: the vine would give its fruit, the land would give its produce, and the heavens would give their dew. Yahweh would make the remnant of that people inherit all these things.
What does Yahweh say he will do for the house of Judah and the house of Israel, who were once a curse among the nations?
Yahweh says he will save them and make them a blessing instead of a curse.
What does Yahweh say he plans to do now, instead of harming the people as he did before?
Yahweh says he now plans to do good to Jerusalem and the house of Judah.
How does Yahweh command the people to behave and why?

Yahweh said the people must all speak truth with their neighbors, and judge in their gates with faithfulness and a peaceful judgment. He said no one may plan evil in his heart against his neighbor, nor love a false oath—Yahweh commanded these things because he hates them.

In light of the fact that the fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh and tenth months were going to be times of joy, gladness and happy festivals for the house of Judah, what were they told to do by Yahweh?
They were told to love faithfulness and peace.
Who did Yahweh say would come to seek him and beg his favor?
Yahweh said many people from many different cities and mighty nations would come to seek Yahweh and beg his favor.
In those days, why will ten men from every language and nation ask to go up to Jerusalem with Yahweh’s people?
They will grab the robe of a man of Judah and ask to go with him because they will have heard that God is with him.
Yahweh’s declaration concerns the land of Hadrach and Damascus, Hamath, and Tyre and Sidon.
What has Tyre done with silver and gold?
Tyre has heaped up silver like dust and refined gold like the mud of the streets.
What does Yahweh say the Lord will do to Tyre?
Yahweh says that the Lord will dispossess her and strike down her wealth on the sea, so she will be devoured by fire.
What will happen to the king of Gaza and to Ashkelon?
The king will perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon will not be inhabited.
What did Yahweh say he would do to the Philistines, and what would become of them?
Yahweh said he would cut off the pride of the Philistines. Yahweh also said they would become a remnant for God, like a clan in Judah.
What is one reason Yahweh gives for camping around his house?
Yahweh said he would camp around his house against enemy armies so no one could pass through or return, for he said that no oppressor would pass through it any more.
Why is the daughter of Zion told to shout with great joy and the daughter of Jerusalem told to shout with happiness?
They are told to do this because their king is coming to them with righteousness and is going to rescue them.
How will their king come to them?
Their king will be humble and will ride on a donkey, on the colt of a donkey.
What will this king speak to the nations?
That king will speak peace to the nations.
What will be the extent of that king’s dominion?
That king’s dominion will be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.
Why has Yahweh set free their prisoners from the pit where there is no water?
Yahweh says he has done this because of the blood of his covenant with them.
What does Yahweh declare he will do for the prisoners of hope?
Yahweh declares that he will return double to them.
Against whom will Yahweh rouse the sons of Zion?
Yahweh will rouse the sons of Zion against the sons of Greece.
What will Yahweh make Zion like?
Yahweh will make Zion like the sword of a mighty man.
What will Yahweh do when he appears over his people?
Yahweh’s arrow will go out like lightning, and he will blow the trumpet and go with the storms of the south.
What will Yahweh do for his people?
Yahweh will protect his people, and they will defeat the enemies who attack them with slingstones.
What will Zion be on that day when Yahweh, their God, rescues them?
On that day, Zion will be the jewels of a crown raised up over Yahweh’s land.
What will make the young men and young women strong?
The young men will grow strong from grain, and the young women will grow strong from new wine.
What will Yahweh do when people ask him for rain?
Yahweh will give them rain showers, and he will make plants grow in the field.
What causes the people to wander like sheep and suffer?
The people wander like sheep and suffer because the household idols speak falsely, the diviners envision a lie, they tell empty dreams, and they give empty comfort. The people also have no shepherd.
Who does Yahweh say he will punish?
Yahweh says he will punish the leaders, whom he calls the male goats.
What does Yahweh say will come from the house of Judah?
Yahweh says the cornerstone, the tent peg, the battle bow, and every ruler will come from the house of Judah.
What will the people’s warriors do because Yahweh is with them?
They will fight like warriors trampling their enemies in the mud of the streets, and they will defeat the horsemen because Yahweh is with them.
What did Yahweh say he would do for the house of Judah and the house of Joseph?
Yahweh said he would strengthen the house of Judah, save the house of Joseph, bring them back, and have compassion on them.
How will the people of Ephraim feel because of what Yahweh has done?
The people of Ephraim will be glad like warriors who have drunk wine, and their children will see it and rejoice in Yahweh.
What will Yahweh do because he has redeemed his people?
Yahweh will whistle for his people and gather them together, and they will become as many as they were before.
What will Judah and Ephraim do when they remember Yahweh in the distant countries where Yahweh has scattered them?
They and their children will live and return when they remember Yahweh in the distant countries where he has scattered them.
Where will Yahweh gather his people from, and where will he bring them?
Yahweh will gather his people from Egypt and Assyria, and he will bring them to the land of Gilead and Lebanon, where there will not be enough room for them.
What did Yahweh say he would do to Assyria and Egypt?
Yahweh said he would bring down the pride of Assyria and take away the scepter of Egypt.
How will the people live after Yahweh strengthens them?
The people will live faithfully, honoring Yahweh’s name.
What is Lebanon told to do?
Lebanon is told to open its doors so that fire can burn up its cedar trees.
What does the fall of the cedar trees cause the cypress trees to do?
It causes the cypress trees to wail.
The shepherds are crying because their pastures have been destroyed.
What did Yahweh tell Zechariah to do?
Yahweh told Zechariah to shepherd the flock that was intended for slaughter.
What do the sellers of the sheep say?
The sellers say they praise Yahweh because they are becoming rich.
What did Yahweh say he would do to the inhabitants of the land?
Yahweh said he would no longer pity them, but would let each man’s neighbor and king dominate him, and they would destroy the land, and he would not rescue them.
What were the names of the two staffs that Zechariah used to shepherd the flock meant for slaughter?
The names of the two staffs were “Favor” and “Union.”
Why did Zechariah destroy three shepherds in one month?
Zechariah did this because he became impatient with the shepherds, and they also hated him.
What did Zechariah say he would no longer do?
Zechariah said he would no longer be their shepherd.
Why did Zechariah break his staff, “Favor?”
He broke it to break the covenant that he had made with all the peoples.
What did the poor of the flock who were watching Zechariah know?
They knew that it was the word of Yahweh.
Zechariah was paid thirty pieces of silver.
What did Yahweh tell Zechariah to do with his thirty pieces of silver?
Yahweh told him to throw it to the potter at the house of Yahweh.
What did breaking the second staff, Union, do?
Breaking the second staff broke the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
What did Yahweh tell Zechariah to take again?
Yahweh told him to take the tools of a foolish shepherd.
Yahweh said he would raise up a shepherd in the land. What will that shepherd do?

That shepherd will not care for the sheep. He will not help the sheep that are perishing, he will not search for the ones that have strayed, and he will not heal the ones that are injured. He will not feed the healthy sheep, but will eat the fattest sheep and tear off their hooves.
What curse is pronounced upon the worthless shepherd who forsakes the flock?
The curse says that a sword will strike the shepherd’s arm and his right eye, and that his arm will wither and his right eye will become blind.
Who is Yahweh who makes this declaration concerning Israel?
Yahweh is the one who stretches out the heavens, lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within him.
What does Yahweh say he will make Jerusalem like for all the surrounding peoples?
Yahweh says he will make Jerusalem like a strong drink that makes all the surrounding peoples stagger.
Who is going to gather against Jerusalem?
All the nations of the earth are going to gather against Jerusalem.
On the day when all the nations gather against Judah, what specific things did Yahweh say he would do to the horses and riders of the enemy armies?
Yahweh said he would strike every horse with confusion and each rider with madness. Yahweh also said he would strike every horse of the enemy nations with blindness.
What will the leaders of Judah say about the people of Jerusalem?
The leaders of Judah will say that the people of Jerusalem are a strength to them through Yahweh of Armies, their God.
In that day, what will the leaders of Judah be like?
In that day, the leaders of Judah will be like a basin of fire among trees and like a torch of fire in a sheaf.
Why will Yahweh save the tents of Judah first?
Yahweh will save the tents of Judah first so that the honor of the house of David and the honor of those who live in Jerusalem may not be greater than the rest of Judah.
What did Yahweh say he will do for the people of Jerusalem on that day?
Yahweh said he will defend the people of Jerusalem, and even the weakest among them will become as strong as David.
What is Yahweh determined to do on that day?
Yahweh said that on that day he is determined to destroy all the nations who come against Jerusalem.
On that day, what will Yahweh pour out on the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem?
Yahweh will pour out a spirit of favor and supplications.
What will the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem do when they look upon him whom they have pierced?
When they look on him whom they have pierced, they will lament and mourn for him as one mourns and laments for an only son or over the death of a firstborn son.
What will the mourning in Jerusalem be like on that day?
The mourning in Jerusalem will be great, like the mourning of Hadad Rimmon in the plain of Megiddo.
How will the land mourn in that day?
The land will mourn by clans: each clan will mourn separately, and within each clan, the men and their wives will mourn separately from each other.
For what will the fountain be that is opened for the house of David on that day?
The fountain will be for their sin and impurity.
What will Yahweh cut off from the land and why?
Yahweh will cut off the names of idols from the land so they will no longer be remembered.
What will Yahweh cause to pass out of the land?
Yahweh will cause the false prophets and their unclean spirits to pass out of the land.
If any man continues to prophesy, what will his father and mother do to him?
His father and mother who bore him will pierce him when he prophesies.
In that day, why will he who prophesies no longer wear a hairy cloak?
He will no longer wear a hairy cloak because he will no longer try to deceive people.
What will the man say about himself instead of admitting he is a prophet?
He will say that he is not a prophet, but works the land for a man who owned him since he was young.
When someone asks about the wounds on his chest, what will the man say?
He will say that someone wounded him at the house of his friends.
The shepherd is the man who is Yahweh’s close companion.
What will happen to the flock when the shepherd is killed?
When the shepherd is killed, the flock will scatter.
What does Yahweh declare will happen throughout all the land?
Yahweh declares that two out of every three people in the land will die, and only one third of the people will remain alive.
What will happen to the third that remain there?
The third that remain there will be brought through the fire, refined, and tested.
What will the third that remain there say?
The third that remain there will say, “Yahweh is my God!”
What will happen to Jerusalem’s possessions on the day that is coming for Yahweh?
Jerusalem’s plunder will be divided up within the city.
Why will Jerusalem’s plunder be divided in their midst?
Jerusalem’s plunder will be divided in their midst because Yahweh will gather every nation against Jerusalem for battle, and the city will be captured. The houses will be plundered.
What will happen to the nations that fought against Jerusalem?
Yahweh will go out and wage war against those nations as when he wages war on a day of battle.
What will happen to the Mount of Olives when Yahweh stands on it?
The Mount of Olives will be split in half, forming a very great valley between the two halves.
When will Yahweh and the holy ones come?
Yahweh and the holy ones will come after the inhabitants of Jerusalem flee down the valley between Yahweh’s mountains.
What will happen to the light on that day?
There will not be light; the bright lights will grow dim.
What will be different about that day?
That day will not follow the normal cycle of day and night, and even in the evening there will be light.
Where will the running water go that flows from Jerusalem?
Half of the water will go to the eastern sea, and half will flow toward the western sea.
Who will be king over all the earth?
Yahweh will be king over all the earth.
What will happen to the land from Geba to Rimmon?
It will become flat like a plain, but Jerusalem will rise up and remain in its place.
There will not be destruction again, and Jerusalem will dwell in security.
With what plague will Yahweh attack all the peoples that waged war against Jerusalem?
The flesh, eyes, and tongues of all the people that waged war against Jerusalem will rot.
What will happen when that great panic from Yahweh comes among them?
Each man will seize his neighbor’s hand; each hand will be raised against its neighbor’s hand.
What will Judah do at Jerusalem?
Judah will fight at Jerusalem, and the wealth of the surrounding nations will be gathered—gold, silver, and garments in great abundance.
What will happen to the animals in the enemies’ camps?
The horses, mules, camels, donkeys, and all the other animals in the camps will be struck with the same plague.
What will all who remain in those nations that came against Jerusalem do?
All those who remain in those nations will go up from year to year to worship the King, Yahweh of Armies, and to celebrate the Festival of Booths.
What will happen if anyone from all the nations of the earth does not go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, Yahweh of Armies?
If anyone does not go up to Jerusalem, Yahweh will not bring rain on them. A plague from Yahweh will attack the nations that do not go up to keep the Festival of Booths.
What will be the sin of Egypt and the other nations?
Their sin will be that they do not go up to celebrate the Festival of Booths.
What will be written on the bells of the horses?
The bells of the horses will be inscribed with words saying that they are holy to Yahweh.
On that day, who will no longer be in the house of Yahweh of Armies?
On that day traders will no longer be selling goods in the house of Yahweh of Armies.
By whom did the word of Yahweh come to Israel?
The word of Yahweh came by Malachi.
Whom did Yahweh love, and whom did he hate?
Yahweh loved Israel, Jacob, and he hated Esau.
How would Israel respond when Yahweh would throw down the rebuilt ruins of Edom?
Israel would respond by saying, “Great is Yahweh beyond the borders of Israel.”
As Israel’s father and master, what did Yahweh ask the priests?
Yahweh asked the priests where was the honor and reverence due his name, and why they despised his name and his table.
How would Yahweh respond to offerings of blind, lame, and sick animals?
Yahweh would not accept blind, lame, and sick offerings, nor show favor or graciousness to Israel for them, nor receive Israel for offering them.
Why would Yahweh prefer that one of the Israelites shut the temple gates to prevent them from lighting fires on his altar in vain?
Because Yahweh’s name was going to be glorified among the nations, and in every place the nations were going to offer pure offerings unlike the offerings from the hands of the Israelites.
How did the priests regard the service of Yahweh?
They regarded it as tiresome, and they disdainfully snorted at it.
Why did the Lord curse the deceiver who vowed to sacrifice a male animal in his flock and instead gave a flawed animal?
Because Yahweh is a great King, and his name is feared among the nations.
By what would the priests know that Yahweh had commanded them to take it to heart to give glory to his name?
They would know by the curse of Yahweh on their blessings, and by him spreading dung on their faces.
Why did Levi honor Yahweh, stand in awe of Yahweh’s name, have true teaching in his mouth rather than unrighteousness, walk with Yahweh in peace and uprightness, and turn many away from sin?
Because the priest should guard knowledge as the messenger of Yahweh.
How did the priests corrupt the covenant of Levi and not keep Yahweh’s ways?
The priests did so by showing partiality in their instruction.
Who would Yahweh cut off from the tents of Jacob?
Yahweh would cut off any man who dealt treacherously against his brother or who married the daughter of a foreign god, and then brought an offering to Yahweh.
Why did Yahweh not accept Israel’s offerings?
Because Israel had dealt treacherously with the wife of his youth.
Why did Yahweh command the Israelites to guard themselves in their spirit and not be faithless?
Because Yahweh had made Israel and his wife one in order to have godly offspring, and because Yahweh hated divorce and him who covers his garment with violence.
How did the Israelites weary Yahweh with their words?
They wearied Yahweh with their words by saying that he who does evil is good in Yahweh’s sight and he delights in them, and by asking where the God of justice was.
What would happen after Yahweh sent his messenger of the covenant who would prepare his way?
The Lord, whom Israel sought, would suddenly come to his temple.
When would the offering of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasing to Yahweh?
It would be pleasing after the purification of the sons of Levi, when they were refined like gold and silver.
After the offerings of Judah and Jerusalem were pleasing to Yahweh through the purification of Levi’s sons, what would Yahweh do?
He would draw near to Israel for judgment and be a swift witness against those who did not honor him.
Even though the people of Jacob had turned aside from Yahweh’s ordinances, why had they not been consumed?
They had not been consumed because Yahweh does not change.
How had Israel turned away from Yahweh?
They had turned away by not keeping his ordinances.
They had robbed God in tithes and offerings.
What did Yahweh promise would happen if Israel brought the full tithe into the storehouse?
Yahweh promised that he would rebuke the one who devours you, and that all the nations would call Israel blessed.
How had the Israelites spoken against Yahweh?
They had said that serving God is pointless because the arrogant and evildoers prosper even when they tempt him.
On the day that Yahweh would act, what would happen?
The Israelites would again distinguish between the righteous and the wicked, and between one who worships God and one who does not worship him.
Who did Yahweh say would belong to him and be spared?
Yahweh said that those who feared Yahweh and esteemed his name would belong to him and be spared.
On the day that was coming, burning like a furnace, what would happen to the proud and evildoers?
The proud and evildoers would become stubble, being burnt up.
What would those who feared Yahweh’s name do on the day that Yahweh acted?
They would go out leaping like calves from the stall and tread down the wicked.
For whom would the sun of righteousness rise?
The sun of righteousness would rise for those who feared Yahweh’s name.
What did Yahweh command all Israel to do?
He commanded them to remember and obey the law of his servant Moses.
What would Yahweh do before the day of Yahweh?
He would send Elijah to turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, so that Yahweh would not curse the land.
